description: Stores and finds orders (in memory to start)

decisions.question: Not found: return None, or raise which domain error?
Who opens and commits the transaction (the service, never the repository)?
decisions.answer: No transaction: memory; the service decides what is saved

decisions.question: Two updates of the same record at the same time: last write wins, a version check, or a lock?
decisions.answer: Last write wins: an order is only created, never updated yet

decisions.question: Which queries can return many rows, and what is their maximum?

questions.title: Personal data
questions.question: Retention: how long is the personal data it writes kept, how is it deleted then, and how is one person's data erased on request (art. 17) - e.g. 5 years, then deleted; one person's rows deleted by id?
questions.answer: In memory: gone when the service stops; nothing kept, nothing to erase on request

questions.title: Personal data
questions.question: Location: in which country or region is it stored? Outside the EU/EEA, which safeguard applies (adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses - art. 46) - e.g. France, cloud region eu-west-3?
questions.answer: The service's own memory, in the EU

safety.question: A dependency down or slow, or the resource does not exist: what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: In memory, in the process: no outside store to be down, one write per change, no cache or replica

safety.question: Too much (unbounded results, duplicated records, a flood of requests): what must never happen?

suggestion.hazard: an unbounded result or a flood of requests overloads the service

safety.question: A change half applied (saved here, not there; a failure mid-transaction): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: In memory, in the process: no outside store to be down, one write per change, no cache or replica

safety.question: Old data shown as current (a cache, a replica, a read that misses the last write): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: In memory, in the process: no outside store to be down, one write per change, no cache or replica

safety.question: Two requests change the same data at the same time (lost update, negative stock): what must never happen?

suggestion.hazard: two simultaneous changes overwrite each other
suggestion.invariant: Last write wins: an order is only created, never updated yet (decision 3)

decision.answer: Last write wins: an order is only created, never updated yet

safety.question: Data exposed (a user sees or changes data that is not theirs; secrets or personal data in a response or a log): what must never happen?

suggestion.hazard: a user sees or changes data that is not theirs, or a secret leaks
suggestion.invariant: a user only reads and changes their own data, and secrets never appear in a response or a log
